# priority

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:priority`](gmeow-priority.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/priority>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The raw X-Priority header value of an email message (typically 1–5). Non-standardised across clients, so stored as a literal rather than a value vocabulary.
